records.replyText: You tap in at the gate on the way down — yellow reader, card or phone — and then you tap out again at the station where you leave. It has to be the same card both times, otherwise the system counts it as an incomplete journey and charges you a maximum fare. And even if a gate happens to be standing open, you still tap it; an open barrier doesn't mean the fare's been taken.
records.translation: 进站的时候在闸机上刷一下——黄色的读卡器，卡或者手机都行——然后出站的时候再刷一次。两次必须是同一张卡，不然系统会算作一次未完成的行程，按最高票价扣钱。还有，就算闸机恰好开着，也还是要刷；闸门开着不代表钱已经扣了。
